title: Fittings-Stock Reduction on Northgate Delivery & Installation Parts Kits
content:
Kit units already standing on an appointment's installation parts kit entries lower the kit price on a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment by a fittings-stock reduction:

| Kit units already standing on the appointment's installation parts kit entries | Reduction off the price of each kit |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | $5.00 |
| Exactly 1 | $2.50 |
| None | No reduction |

The reduction comes off the price of each kit itself, so every amount worked out from the price of a kit is worked out from the lowered price. The units counted are those of every installation parts kit entry already on the appointment, taken together.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- An appointment with one installation parts kit entry carrying 2 kits: $5.00 off each kit.
- An appointment with two entries of 1 kit each: 2 kits standing, $5.00 off each kit.
- An appointment with one entry of 1 kit: $2.50 off each kit.
- An appointment with no installation parts kit entry: no reduction.
